# ui::ClassicBevelRamp

Header: `winui/ui/themes/ClassicPalette.hpp`.

The classic 3-D bevel ramp: the four rings [draw_bevel_border()](../rendering/namespace-ui.md#draw_bevel_border) draws around a raised or sunken classic control.

Usually derived from a face color with [classic_bevel_ramp_from_face()](namespace-ui.md#classic_bevel_ramp_from_face). A scheme that states its own ramp, such as High Contrast Black, sets [ClassicPalette::bevel](classic-palette.md#bevel) instead.

Example: 
```cpp
// In a custom control's render_override(): a sunken well on Windows 95's gray, whose ramp is
// `#DFDFDF`, white, `#808080` and black.
class WellControl : public ui::Element
{
protected:
    void render_override(ui::Renderer& renderer, const ui::RenderContext&) const override
    {
        const ui::ClassicBevelRamp ramp = ui::classic_bevel_ramp_from_face(ui::Color::from_argb(0xFFC0C0C0));
        ui::draw_bevel_border(renderer, bounds(), ui::BorderStyle::Sunken, ramp.light, ramp.highlight,
                              ramp.shadow, ramp.dark_shadow, 1.0f);
    }
};
```

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `light` | `Color` |  | The outer top/left ring, a step lighter than the face. |
| `highlight` | `Color` |  | The inner top/left ring, the brightest edge (white on the standard grays). |
| `shadow` | `Color` |  | The inner bottom/right ring, a mid gray on the standard grays. |
| `dark_shadow` | `Color` |  | The outer bottom/right ring, the darkest edge. |
